pages.text: $(thing)Farms$(): all.$(br2)A farm only works while its chunk is loaded. This card keeps the $(item)chunk the farm stands in$() loaded, so the farm keeps working when you are far away or logged out.$(br2)It uses vanilla forced chunks (they show in $(thing)/forceload list$()). Breaking the farm or removing the card releases the chunk, unless /forceload holds it too. Several farms in one chunk share it.
